scientific_integrity: An asymptotic theorem for ordinary Euclidean classical parking-function polytopes. The logarithmic covariance variational argument and quartic factorization provide an analytic proof; finite checks only corroborate. No assertion of finite-n formulas, exhaustive finite-n contacts, or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the classical parking-function polytopes, not all generalized parking-function polytopes.
Leading-order center/semiaxes and contact accumulation, not finite-dimensional exact ellipsoid coefficients.
Prior-work review cannot rule out equivalent results under optimal design terminology.
title: Golden-ratio anisotropy of the Löwner ellipsoids of parking-function polytopes
